## Problem

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Steps to reproduce

Include the operating system, Node version, command or browser flow. Use **synthetic data**, never tokens or private activity.

## Evidence

Share an error trace with secrets removed, or screenshots of before/after visuals. Mention whether the source was synthetic demo or a verified GitHub calendar.

## Relevant files or area

Renderer / collector / browser / export / tests / documentation / CI.

## Checklist

- [ ] I did not include access tokens, private repo names or other secrets
- [ ] I checked existing open issues
- [ ] I confirmed the behaviour on the current default branch where practical
